note: Clinical glossary (FEF-039, ADR-11). Every term has one id; screens, Rx print and message templates reference the id. 'approved' lists the languages whose text in messages/<lang>/glossary.json a clinician has reviewed. Never machine-translate a term; add a language here only after clinical review. This file and messages/*/glossary.json need CODEOWNERS approval from the clinical reviewers.

allergy.label.definition: Name of the allergy section and column; a recorded hypersensitivity to a substance.

allergy.plural.definition: Heading for the list of a patient's recorded allergies.

allergy.nkaDocumented.definition: A clinician asked and documented that the patient has no known allergies. Different from 'none recorded'.

allergy.notYetAsked.definition: Nobody has documented the patient's allergies yet. Must never read as 'no known allergies'.

allergy.warning.title.definition: Title of a prescription warning raised when a medicine matches a recorded allergy.

allergy.warning.conflict.definition: Body of the allergy warning; {message} names the matched allergy.

allergy.severity.severe.definition: Allergy severity: severe reaction. A severe allergy blocks signing until a clinician decides.

pregnancy.label.definition: Name of the pregnancy and lactation status of the patient.

pregnancy.warning.title.definition: Title of a prescription warning raised for a medicine flagged for pregnancy or lactation.

pregnancy.status.unknown.definition: Recorded pregnancy status: the patient is unsure.

controlled.warning.title.definition: Title of the warning for a controlled (scheduled) medicine.

warning.advisory.definition: Marks a warning that is shown but does not block signing.

warning.decisionRecorded.definition: A clinician's override or acknowledgement of a warning has been recorded.

soap.reason.definition: Consultation step 1: why the patient came (subjective).

soap.plan.definition: Consultation step 4: plan, prescription, orders and follow-up.

soap.presentingComplaint.definition: The main problem the patient reports at this visit.

rx.prescription.definition: A prescription: the signed list of medicines for a visit.

rx.medicines.definition: The medicine lines of a prescription.

rx.sig.definition: Directions for taking a medicine, such as 1-0-1 after food.

rx.route.definition: How a medicine is given (for example oral).

rx.dosage.definition: Strength per dose, as typed by the prescriber.

rx.dose.definition: Amount of a medicine taken at one time.

rx.frequency.definition: How often the medicine is taken.

rx.duration.definition: For how long the medicine is taken.

rx.quantity.definition: Amount of the medicine to dispense.

rx.instructions.definition: Free-text directions for the patient or pharmacist.

rx.safetyChecks.definition: The allergy, pregnancy and controlled-substance checks run on a prescription.

rx.slot.morning.definition: Morning dose slot of a 1-0-1 style sig.

rx.slot.noon.definition: Noon dose slot of a 1-0-1 style sig.

rx.slot.night.definition: Night dose slot of a 1-0-1 style sig.

vitals.label.definition: Measured vital signs of the visit.

diagnosis.label.definition: The clinician's diagnosis for the visit.

condition.chronic.definition: Chronic conditions recorded for the patient.
